questions.subject: Karnataka History
questions.question: What does the term 'ancient Karnataka' broadly refer to in historical study?

options.A: Only the history of the Mysore Kingdom
options.B: The history of the Kannada-speaking Deccan from prehistoric and early historic times through the early medieval period
options.C: The history of the Vijayanagara Empire alone
options.D: The history of British administration in Karnataka

questions.explanation: Ancient Karnataka refers broadly to the history of the Kannada-speaking Deccan from prehistoric and early historic times through the early medieval period; political boundaries and the extent of Kannada-speaking regions changed over time.

questions.subject: Karnataka History
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a source used to reconstruct ancient Karnataka history?

options.D: Modern census reports of the 20th century

questions.explanation: Sources include inscriptions, copper-plate grants, coins, literary works, archaeological remains, temples, sculptures, foreign accounts and genealogies of ruling dynasties. Modern census reports are not a source for ancient history.

questions.subject: Karnataka History
questions.question: Which language is especially important for reconstructing the political and cultural history of Karnataka?
questions.explanation: Kannada is especially important, alongside Sanskrit and, in some regions and periods, Prakrit.

questions.subject: Karnataka History
questions.question: What is the significance of the Halmidi inscription?

options.A: It is the earliest record of the Vijayanagara Empire
options.B: It is among the earliest substantial records in Kannada and an important source for the development of Kannada as an administrative and literary language
options.C: It records the Battle of Talikota
options.D: It is the first inscription issued by the British

questions.explanation: The Halmidi inscription, generally dated to around the fifth or sixth century CE, is among the earliest substantial records in Kannada and is an important source for the development of Kannada as an administrative and literary language.

questions.subject: Karnataka History
questions.question: The Halmidi inscription is generally dated to which period?

options.A: Around the fifth or sixth century CE

questions.explanation: The Halmidi inscription is generally dated to around the fifth or sixth century CE.

questions.subject: Karnataka History
questions.question: Which dynasty is traditionally regarded as the first major indigenous Kannada ruling dynasty?
questions.explanation: The Kadambas of Banavasi are generally regarded as the earliest important native dynasty to rule a substantial part of Karnataka.

questions.subject: Karnataka History
questions.question: Who founded the Kadamba dynasty?
questions.explanation: Mayurasharma (also written Mayuravarma) is traditionally credited with founding the Kadamba dynasty in the fourth century CE.

questions.subject: Karnataka History
questions.question: What was the capital of the early Kadambas?
questions.explanation: Banavasi, in present-day Uttara Kannada district, was the principal capital of the early Kadambas.

questions.subject: Karnataka History
questions.question: Which Kadamba ruler is one of the best-known early rulers, noted for political standing and matrimonial alliances?
questions.explanation: Kakusthavarma is one of the best-known early Kadamba rulers and is noted in inscriptions for his political standing and matrimonial alliances.

questions.subject: Karnataka History
questions.question: What was the historical importance of the Kadambas?

options.A: They established an important early regional kingdom in Karnataka, supported Sanskrit and Kannada, issued land grants, and helped develop local political and administrative institutions
options.B: They built the Kailasa temple at Ellora

questions.subject: Karnataka History
questions.question: Which script and languages appear in Kadamba-period records?

questions.subject: Karnataka History
questions.question: What is the significance of the Talagunda inscription?

options.A: It provides an important account of Mayurasharma's origins and the rise of the Kadamba dynasty

questions.subject: Karnataka History
questions.question: Which dynasty ruled parts of southern Karnataka and is commonly called the Western Gangas?

questions.explanation: His forces used iron-cased rockets, which influenced later British military rocket development.

questions.subject: Karnataka History

questions.subject: Karnataka History

questions.subject: Karnataka History
